ErikaBeforeBattleText:
ERIKA: Hello…
Lovely weather,

isn't it?
It's so pleasant…

…I'm afraid I may
doze off…

My name is ERIKA.
I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.

…Oh? All the way
from JOHTO, you say? How nice…

Oh. I'm sorry, I
didn't realize

that you wished to
challenge me.

Very well, but I
shall not lose.
ErikaBeatenText:
ERIKA: Oh!
I concede defeat…

You are remarkably
strong…

I shall give you
RAINBOWBADGE…
ErikaExplainTMText:
ERIKA: That was a
delightful match.

I felt inspired.
Please, I wish you to have this TM.

It is GIGA DRAIN.

It is a wonderful
move that drains

half the damage it
inflicts to heal your #MON.

Please use it if
it pleases you…
ErikaAfterBattleText:
ERIKA: Losing
leaves a bitter aftertaste…

But knowing that
there are strong

trainers spurs me
to do better…
LassMichelleSeenText:
Do you think a
girls-only GYM is rare?
LassMichelleAfterBattleText:
I just got care-
less, that's all!
PicnickerTanyaSeenText:
Oh, a battle?
That's kind of scary, but OK!
PicnickerTanyaAfterBattleText:
Oh, look at all
your BADGES. No

wonder I couldn't
win!
BeautyJuliaSeenText:
Were you looking
at these flowers or at me?
BeautyJuliaAfterBattleText:
How do I go about
becoming ladylike like ERIKA?
TwinsJoAndZoe1SeenText:
We'll show you
#MON moves that ERIKA taught us!
TwinsJoAndZoe1AfterBattleText:
ERIKA will get you
back for us!
